app.name: EV tile
app.summary: Your electric car on a tile: its picture, the battery as a bar and the range it has left.
app.battery_hint: The sensor with the battery's charge in percent.
app.range_hint: The sensor with the range the car has left. The tile always shows it in km: metres and miles are turned into km.
app.decimals_hint: As Home Assistant gives it, or rounded. A range in metres or miles is turned into whole km unless you choose One.
app.low_hint: At or below this charge the bar turns red.
app.fit_hint: Contain shows the whole car; cover fills the space and cuts away what is over.
